name: com.github.shenyuanqing.zxingsimplify.zxing.Activity.CaptureActivity
description: The ZXing Simplify library opens a camera scanner for QR codes and barcodes, with a flashlight and an option to scan an image from the gallery; it returns the decoded text to the caller.
disableEffect: QR-code or barcode scanning that uses this library will stop working.
